selection.RATIONALE: PyTorch Connectomics was runtime-qualified but failed its non-protected DVID target-compatibility smoke. Bootstrapper requires non-raw-EM upstream inputs and unavailable weights; LSD has no documented released 3-D checkpoint; MOSS's bundled 2-D checkpoint lacks sufficient weight provenance and a 3-D contract. Per the bounded-audit escalation rule, do not cycle further through ambiguous models.
